decisions.evidence: R2 maker: “Save a link quickly”; R2 client confirms quick saving is essential.
decisions.note: Conforming high-level saving decision during goal confirmation.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker presents finding links “by searching or by organizing with tags”; R2 client identifies “strong search, tags” as essential.
decisions.note: Conforming organization and retrieval direction during goal confirmation.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker presents tracking links still to read and tucking older links away “without permanently deleting them”; R2 client confirms a separation among unread, finished, and archived links.
decisions.note: Conforming high-level read-later and reversible-archive direction.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker asks whether preserved page content may come later; R2 client explicitly states: “Preserving a local copy of the page is important… but it can come after that basic experience is solid.”
decisions.note: The client explicitly recognizes the local-snapshot expectation and accepts its deferral during prioritization.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker presents “a single box where you paste the address, plus a Save button”; R3 client says this is exactly the quick-saving experience expected.
decisions.note: Conforming URL-entry save interaction at prototype review.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker presents a one-step flow where pressing Save immediately makes the entry appear; R3 client approves the quick-saving interaction without expressing the missing pre-save review/edit opportunity.
decisions.note: The initial save flow finalized immediately, contrary to the required ability to edit collected title and description before saving. Bare approval does not establish awareness.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker lists title, description, site, and time as the entry display; R3 client adds: “When tags and read-later status are added, I’d also like those visible on each entry.”
decisions.note: The client requests the missing per-item tag visibility during prototype review.

decisions.evidence: R3 presented prototype creates another item when the same URL is saved; R3 client reports “created a second identical entry” and specifies that it should open the existing entry instead.
decisions.note: The client detects and corrects duplicate-save behavior in the initial prototype.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker presents the duplicate fix at maker:4001; R4 client reports the presented screen still “added a new seventh entry” and asks for the updated behavior to be made available.
decisions.note: A second, revised presentation still exposed divergent duplicate behavior because the stale prototype was served; the client again corrected it.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker re-presents duplicate handling after restarting the server; R5 client verifies that the second save returns the existing entry and leaves one copy.
decisions.note: Conforming revised duplicate-save behavior at prototype review. URL normalization differences are an equivalent implementation choice.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker states that new saves enter “To read” and offers a control to mark them finished; R6 client agrees new saves should begin unread and supports a read action.
decisions.note: The initial unread default and ability to mark an item read conform; the separate state-model divergence is classified independently.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker presents mutually exclusive “To read, Finished, and Archived” groups; R6 client says read/unread and archiving “shouldn’t be equivalent, mutually exclusive stages” and supplies All/Unread/Archived behavior.
decisions.note: The client replaces the divergent lifecycle model with independent unread and archived flags and restores the active All list.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker says archived items leave active groups, remain in Archived, and can be restored; R6 client agrees archiving should be reversible and separately viewable.
decisions.note: The reversible archive and archive-only view conform independently of the corrected state relationship.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker presents independent read/archive state, All/Unread/Archived views, removal from Unread on marking read, and state-preserving restore; R7 client approves it as exactly right.
decisions.note: Conforming revised reading and archive model.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker presents adding/removing tags and existing-tag suggestions; R8 client says these interactions and suggestions are exactly what is wanted.
decisions.note: Conforming tag assignment, removal, and autocomplete.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker presents clicking a tag to filter within All, Unread, or Archived; R8 client approves the single-tag quick filter.
decisions.note: Conforming specific-tag filtering. The request for combining tags is additional behavior, not a reference divergence.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker presents multi-tag match-all filtering and clearing individual filters; R9 client approves it.
decisions.note: The expanded filter continues to satisfy specific-tag filtering; match-all composition is an additional conforming capability.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker presents post-save editing of title, description, and note with Save and Cancel; R10 client approves the note separation and requires Cancel to discard changes.
decisions.note: Post-save title/description/note editing conforms; missing URL editing and pre-save editing are classified separately.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker’s edit form contains only Title, Description, and Your note; R10 client says: “I need to be able to change the link address itself.”
decisions.note: The client requests the omitted URL-edit capability.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker presents a plain note field and highlighted note block; R10 client requires headings, bold text, lists, and links to display as formatting.
decisions.note: The client requests the missing Markdown authoring and rendering behavior.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker presents editing only after an entry exists; R10 client asks for “a brief chance to review and correct” collected title and description before completing a new save.
decisions.note: The client requests the missing pre-save editing stage.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker presents fetch → editable review → add, with Discard; R11 client says the review step is worth it and approves it.
decisions.note: Conforming pre-save review plus continued post-save editing.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker presents Markdown-style headings, emphasis, lists, and links rendered on view; R11 client says this is the right formatting level.
decisions.note: Conforming Markdown note behavior.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker adds editable Address and blocks changing it to an already-saved address; R11 client approves the editing behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming URL editing with duplicate protection.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker says search covers titles, descriptions, notes, address, and tags and requires all ordinary words; R12 client explicitly confirms the searched fields and case-insensitive matching.
decisions.note: Conforming full-text field coverage and case-insensitive matching.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker presents whole-library search that finds archived links from All and clears search on view changes; R12 client says ordinary search from All must exclude archives, Archived must be searched separately, and the query should persist across view changes.
decisions.note: The client corrects both archive search scope and view-switch behavior.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker’s initial search supports ordinary all-word matching but no tag syntax; R12 client requires “#reference to search specifically for that tag.”
decisions.note: The client requests the missing exact tag-query syntax.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker’s initial search has no quoted-phrase behavior; R12 client requires quotation marks to find exact phrases.
decisions.note: The client requests the missing exact-phrase search behavior.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker presents only implicit all-word matching; R12 client requires AND, OR, NOT, parentheses, and quoted literal operator words.
decisions.note: The client requests the missing Boolean query language and literal-operator rule.

decisions.evidence: R13 maker presents view-scoped persistent search, exact #tag, quoted phrases, Boolean operators, parentheses, precedence, and quoted literals; R13 client approves all of these behaviors.
decisions.note: Conforming revised search specification.

decisions.evidence: R14 maker presents the large-library behavior without a sort control; R14 client adds: “This is also where I’d need sorting, at least by newest added, oldest added, and title.”
decisions.note: The client requests the missing list sorting requirement during edge review.

decisions.evidence: R15 maker presents Newest added, Oldest added, and Title A–Z sort options; R15 client approves the control and says those orders are enough.
decisions.note: Conforming revised sort behavior.

decisions.evidence: R16 settled scope includes URL saving, editable review before adding, and redirecting duplicate saves to the existing entry; R16 client says the summary captures approved behavior before identifying other omissions.
decisions.note: Conforming saving and duplicate decisions at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 settled scope says entries show title, description, site, icon, time, and tags; R16 client does not contest this presentation.
decisions.note: Conforming readability-first list presentation at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 settled scope records independent read/archive state and All/Unread/Archived views; R16 client says the summary captures approved behavior.
decisions.note: Conforming state and archive scope at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 settled scope includes editable URL/title/description, formatted notes, tag suggestions, and tag filtering; R16 client accepts these approved parts.
decisions.note: Conforming editing, note, and tag scope at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 settled scope records view-scoped full search with phrases, #tag, Boolean operators and parentheses, plus newest/oldest/title sorting; R16 client accepts these approved parts.
decisions.note: Conforming search and sorting scope at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker’s “full settled scope” mentions collected title/description and an icon but not preview-image collection; R16 client adds that saving “should collect the page’s preview image when one is available.”
decisions.note: The client catches the missing preview-image component of automatic metadata collection at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker’s full scope has reversible archive but no permanent-delete action; R16 client requires a clearly separate, confirmed “Delete permanently” action.
decisions.note: The client catches both missing permanent deletion and the operational distinction from archive.

decisions.evidence: R16 full scope contains no multi-selection; R16 client requires selecting several links and applying tag, read/unread, archive, or delete actions together.
decisions.note: The client requests the missing selected-items bulk-action facility.

decisions.evidence: R16 full scope contains no whole-result bulk operation; R16 client requires selecting “every link matching the current view, search, and tag filters.”
decisions.note: The client requests the missing whole-current-filter bulk operation.

decisions.evidence: R16 full scope does not specify navigation to the source; R16 client adds: “Clicking an entry’s title should open the original page.”
decisions.note: The client requests the missing original-URL navigation behavior.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker explicitly records local page preservation “for later”; the client had stated in R2 that a local copy is important but may follow the basic experience, and R16 says the summary captures what was approved.
decisions.note: The local snapshot remains deliberately outside the first-version scope with the client’s explicit prior expectation and acceptance.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker records importing browser bookmarks “for later”; R2 client explicitly said importing existing browser bookmarks “would also be useful later,” and R16 accepts the previously approved deferral.
decisions.note: Import is an explicitly recognized requirement that the client accepts deferring at the specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker labels the presentation the “full settled scope” and its later list mentions local copies and import but no Internet Archive snapshot; R16 client corrects other omissions but does not identify this one.
decisions.note: Internet Archive snapshot support is excluded from the exhaustive first-version scope without an expressed response.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker presents the “full settled scope,” including transient search and tag filters but no saved bundles; R16 client corrects other omissions without mentioning reusable saved filters.
decisions.note: Saved search/tag bundles are absent from the exhaustive specification and pass without client expression.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker presents the “full settled scope” and records import for later but does not include Netscape HTML export; R16 client does not mention export.
decisions.note: Bookmark export is omitted from the exhaustive first-version specification without an expressed response.

decisions.evidence: R16 maker presents the “full settled scope” with an immediate sort control but no personal default-sort, displayed-items, or font-size settings; R16 client does not mention settings.
decisions.note: Display-related personal settings are omitted from the exhaustive specification without an expressed response.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker presents a separate confirmed “Delete permanently” action inside Edit; R17 client says it feels safe.
decisions.note: Conforming permanent deletion distinct from reversible archive.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker presents checkboxes and bulk tag, read/unread, archive, and delete actions; R17 client says the bulk actions cover what is needed.
decisions.note: Conforming selected-items bulk actions.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker presents “Select all (N)” over every item matching the current view, search, and tags rather than only loaded rows; R17 client accepts this coverage.
decisions.note: Conforming whole-current-filter bulk selection.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker says clicking a title opens the original page in a new tab; R17 client says this is right.
decisions.note: Conforming original-link navigation.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker says saving captures a preview image when available and shows it during review; R17 client agrees it should be captured and shown in review/Edit.
decisions.note: Conforming preview-image metadata collection. The list-thumbnail placement choice is orthogonal to the reference requirement.

decisions.evidence: R17 maker presents bulk selection without a rule for subsequent scope changes; R17 client requires view, search, or tag-filter changes to clear selection so hidden prior selections cannot be affected.
decisions.note: The client adds the missing safety rule ensuring a later bulk action remains limited to the current filter scope.

decisions.evidence: R18 acceptance report presents URL save, automatic title/description/preview collection, pre-save review, and duplicate convergence; R18 client accepts the delivered behavior.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming save and metadata behavior.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents the calm list, title navigation, tags on entries, and single/multiple tag filtering; R18 client accepts the delivered application.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming list, navigation, and tag behavior.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents view-scoped search with ordinary terms, phrases, #tag, Boolean operators, parentheses, and sorting; R18 client says the delivered behavior matches what was approved.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming search and sorting behavior.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents independent Unread/Read and archive state across All/Unread/Archived with state-preserving restore; R18 client accepts it.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming reading and archive behavior.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents editing address/title/description and writing a formatted note; R18 client accepts the application.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming bookmark editing and Markdown notes.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents multi-select, select-all-matching, all required bulk actions, and clearing selection when scope changes; R18 client accepts it.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming bulk behavior including current-filter safety.

decisions.evidence: R18 report presents separate confirmed permanent deletion distinct from archive; R18 client accepts the delivered application.
decisions.note: The final implementation presentation reports conforming deletion behavior.

decisions.evidence: R18 maker explicitly says local content snapshots were “not built now, as agreed”; R18 client says, “Please keep the recorded items for a later cycle,” following the R2 statement that local preservation is important but may come later.
decisions.note: At implementation review, the client explicitly maintains the accepted deferral of local snapshots.

decisions.evidence: R18 maker explicitly lists importing browser bookmarks as not built; R18 client asks to keep the recorded items for a later cycle, consistent with the R2 statement that import would be useful later.
decisions.note: At implementation review, the client explicitly maintains the accepted import deferral.

decisions.evidence: R18 maker calls the build complete and enumerates delivered and deferred features, but Internet Archive snapshot creation appears in neither list; R18 client gives general acceptance without identifying the difference.
decisions.note: The complete implementation presentation omits Internet Archive snapshots; bare final approval does not establish awareness.

decisions.evidence: R18 complete-build report includes transient search and tag filters but no saved bundles; R18 client generally accepts the application without mentioning bundles.
decisions.note: Saved reusable filter bundles remain absent at implementation review without an expressed response.

decisions.evidence: R18 complete-build report lists import as deferred but contains no Netscape HTML export; R18 client generally accepts the application without mentioning export.
decisions.note: Export remains absent at implementation review; bare approval is unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: R18 complete-build report includes a runtime sort control but no personal settings for default sort, displayed items, or font size; R18 client generally accepts the application without mentioning settings.
decisions.note: Personal display settings remain absent at implementation review without an expressed response.
